content.short: A Cardano wallet messaging protocol that allows a user to message other Cardano wallets either directly or within a group chat or a community.
content.description:
Web3 and blockchain are starting to become like their own countries. You can see this all across social media with users supporting one chain or another. Blockchain is the currency but we are missing the communication. Mercury Chat's mission is to provide a communication layer for the users on Cardano to talk directly to each other or within communities highlighting everything from SPOs to NFT communities to DEX trading.

Mercury as a communication layer can be embedded directly into applications and provide seamless user communication based on Cardano wallets. Now any Cardano application can embed chat directly into their App!
